_about: MPPP site definitions: the sol range of each block that notebook 03 aligns. Keys are the site names used in folder names (v0p53: mars2020_sol_<first sol, 4 digits>_<site>_colmap; ..._colmap_zcam for the Navcam + Mastcam-Z block). 'sols' = a list of visits [[first, last], ...] (inclusive; [[first, last]] for one visit - version 5) - the first is the main visit (it names the folder mars2020_sol_<its first sol>_...), the others the sols the rover came back on; every visit is selected, and Navcam visits more than 100 sols apart get their own rig rotation (rig epochs). Nearby waypoints (ADD_NEARBY_WAYPOINTS) can still add other visits. Since v0p75 the pipeline's Navcam consensus uses the sites of the navcam_consensus group only (one block per site). 'notes' = free text (every site has one; 'note' before version 5). 'zcam' = the Mastcam-Z zooms (mm) of the site's Navcam + Mastcam-Z block, a list of 34, 48, 63, 79, 110 ([] = Navcam only; v0p53, replaces 'zcam34': true). 'settings' = notebook 03 overrides for this site (JSON values), applied by scripts/run_sites.py and scripts/align_scape.py. 'no_mask_inference_at' = stations (S###D####) where the mask model is off. Groups name site lists for run_sites.py --group; run_all_sites.bat runs navcam_consensus, run_all_sites_zcam.bat zcam_consensus (each site with the zooms of its 'zcam' list), run_all_sites_zcam34.bat zcam34_consensus (48, 63, 79 and 110 likewise). Version 5 (v0p81, 17 Oct 2026): 'official_blocks' (top level) = the official numbered blocks of rover stations from mppp.maps (numbered by first sol: name, 'site' = the site that runs it, region, kind, centre, half_size_m 30, visits, end-of-drive sols, Navcam 360 and Mastcam-Z 360 counts); per site 'official_blocks' = the numbers of the blocks it includes or is part of ([] for none). Every site and block records 'max_waypoint_separation_m' (largest horizontal distance between two waypoints on its sols), 'n_waypoints' and 'rover_sites' (the rover localisation sites: waypoint offsets are shared within one). Groups blocks_all and blocks_<region> list the sites of the official blocks; navcam_baseline the large blocks of the Navcam baseline study. scripts/sites_v5.py waypoints --refresh --write updates the waypoint fields from a newer JPL file. Edit here, then run check_sites.bat; notebook 03 reads this file (SITES_FILE).
